responsibility: Defines ISO raw I/O over the default input and output channels for arrays of SYSTEM.LOC. It is the standard-channel convenience counterpart of RawIO, exposing uninterpreted storage-unit reads and writes while relying on the shared IOChan read-result mechanism for reporting end-of-input or format-related outcomes.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public declaration of default-channel raw storage-unit I/O, exposing Read and Write over ARRAY OF SYSTEM.LOC. It differs from SRawIO.mod, which contains the actual delegation to RawIO on the standard channels.
